message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2 in `npm test`.

The one failure was a wrong expectation in the test, not a bug in the code. `test/vat.test.js` asserted `withVat(250) === 301`. The source applies 20% VAT and rounds to the nearest penny, and 250 × 1.2 = 300 exactly, so no rounding rule gives 301. I changed that assertion to 300 and left `src/vat.js` untouched.

The change is uncommitted in the working tree. I didn't commit because you didn't ask for one.
